show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Ron Biscardi – Inside iConnections Global Alts (EP.367)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Ron Biscardi, the CEO of iConnections.
reader_summary.overview: Ron Biscardi, the CEO of iConnections, whose Global Alts conference in Miami is the largest capital introduction gathering in the industry. In addition to the annual event, iConnections hosts an annual charity cap intro event and provides its technology platform to connect the industry year-round. Last week, I joined 6,000 industry peers in Miami at Global Alts.

key_points.text: The main event at the conference were an incredible 15,000 one-on-one meetings between allocators and managers.
As a side show, I grabbed Ron on the podcast stage to get a closer look at how it all comes together.
In an industry that typically competes at every turn, iConnections is the opposite – they are the ultimate collaborators.
